kinds.prevents: source is a prevent-type status; once landed it blocks the target tag on the holder: only effects cast in a later round where the handler passes the effect, any active one otherwise (see the note and the tag's prevent_check)
kinds.hides: while active on the holder, the source removes actions that carry the target tag from the holder's action list (availableUserActions, server-enforced); effects already cast are untouched
kinds.removes: source strips the target tag (Clear: all positive; Cleanse: all negative; persistent sources excepted)
kinds.transfers: source clones the target tag between fighters (Copy: enemy positive to caster; Mirror: caster's negative to enemy)
kinds.boosts: source raises the target tag's number (potency, damage multipliers, heal multipliers, stats, weakness, pool spend)
kinds.weakens: source lowers the target tag's number
kinds.counters: source reduces, soaks, cancels or blocks what the target tag does
kinds.bypasses: source ignores or destroys the target tag's protection
kinds.feeds: source produces the number the target tag reads (usually damage dealt or taken)
kinds.disables: source switches the target tag off while active
kinds.shares: source and target share a cap
kinds.overlaps: design overlap: both tags own the same kind of outcome (used by the exclusion rule); not an engine interaction
